call_points.text: Net loan book target is set at approximately ₹5,000 crores by the end of FY27.
About ₹2,000 Cr of the FY26 sanctions is undisbursed; ₹1,500 Cr of it is expected within the next two quarters.
Prepayments of ₹1,105 Cr and total repayments of ₹1,441 Cr moderated AUM; prepayments are not predictable.
The company holds ₹1,800 Cr of liquidity and did not borrow in FY26; fresh borrowing will wait for disbursement needs.
NIM rose to 4.49% from 4.25%; the base rate was cut 60 bps and cost of funds is expected to fall on fresh borrowing.
Q4 yield on the earning portfolio softened to 10.29% from 11.27% a year ago.
CRISIL removed the rating from 'Watch with Developing Implications' and reaffirmed CRISIL A (Negative)/A1.
MD & CEO R. Balaji resigned for personal reasons and serves till 30 June; the board has started the replacement process.
call_points.versus_prior: watchlist item on new MD & CEO appointment remains open

call_points.text: No FY26 dividend was declared; management said the board will review it next quarter.
100% of FY26 disbursements went to private corporate borrowers, with new forays into data centres and compressed biogas.

operating_notes.text: Secured NCDs issued by the company have been fully redeemed as of March 31, 2026.
The company will discontinue preparing consolidated financials from FY 2026-27 following write-off and liquidation of associates.
Loan sanctions for FY26 reached ₹3,448 Cr while disbursements stood at ₹1,235 Cr.
FY26 sanctions ₹3,448 Cr vs ₹825 Cr in FY25; disbursements ₹1,235 Cr vs ₹916 Cr.

Board approved postal ballot notice to seek shareholder approval for appointing Shri Rajiv Malhotra as Non-Executive Nominee Director of holding company PTC India Limited w.e.f. April 8, 2026.
Shri Rajiv Malhotra appointed as MD&CEO (Addl. Charge) from July 1, 2026, to November 30, 2026.
Company achieved the requisite requirement of minimum infrastructure finance exposure of 75% of total assets.
Q2FY27 loan assets stood at ₹3,684 crores.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹119.08 Cr; net profit ₹45.5 Cr (-21.8% YoY).
PFS reported Q4FY26 PAT of ₹46 Cr and full-year FY26 loan sanctions of ₹3,448 Cr with Gross Stage III falling to ₹190 Cr.
PTC India Financial Services Limited shared the audio recording link of its Investors’ Call on May 5, 2026, at 6:00 PM (IST), discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 results.

PFS's Q4/FY26 call (May 5, 2026) guided 30-50% AUM growth for FY27, reported FY26 sanctions of ₹3,448 Cr and gross Stage III down to ₹190 Cr, and confirmed MD & CEO R. Balaji's resignation effective June 30, 2026.
PFS board approved seeking shareholder approval via Postal Ballot for the appointment of Shri Rajiv Malhotra as Nominee Director.
PTC India Financial Services appointed Shri Rajiv Malhotra as MD&CEO with additional charge effective July 1, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹110.19 Cr (-16.4% YoY), net profit ₹44.04 Cr (-50.0% YoY).
PTC India Financial Services released its Q2FY27 investor presentation highlighting a return to core infrastructure financing and AUM growth.
PTC India Financial Services reported an 8-year high in loan sanctions at ₹3,098 Cr and improved asset quality for Q2 FY27.

PTC India Financial Services Limited provided a link to the audio recording of its Investors’ Call held on 28 October 2026 at 4:00 PM (IST) on the Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026.
PTC India Financial Services reported Q2 FY27 earnings with AUM growing 25% sequentially to ₹3,684 crores and loan sanctions hitting a 36-quarter high.
